summary: Frontend-only verification (iteration 8) of the Facebook social-preview artwork fix. ALL primary acceptance criteria PASS: (1) FB modal opens via [data-testid=social-footer-icon-facebook]; (2) sidebar 'Fotos' preview shows 3 DIFFERENT motives (1-tagesgeld, 2-festgeld, 3-zinsen) all with naturalWidth 150 — no identical placeholder repetition; (3) 'Alle ansehen' lightbox cycles 6/6 distinct photos with correct captions (Tagesgeld -> Festgeld -> Zinsen -> Einlagensicherung -> Vermoegensaufbau -> Europa), all loaded; (4) Fotos tab renders exactly 6 unique SVGs, 0 broken; (5) Feed shows 6 FV posts, each with a UNIQUE image that matches its topic text (tagesgeld-post/tagesgeld.svg etc.), 0 broken; (6) comments are topic-specific and unique per post (Sandra Weiss/Patrick Albrecht at Tagesgeld, Nicole Brandt 24-Monate at Festgeld, Ralf Schubert Zins-Benachrichtigung at Zinsen, Christian Ade EU-Schutz at Einlagensicherung, Monika Drechsler Sparrate at Vermoegensaufbau, Petra Lindemann Aufwand at Europa); (7) all company replies authored 'Froehlich Vermoegensberatung GmbH'; (8) grep: 0 'kapitalmitte' occurrences in /src/data/social/ and /src/components/social/, and 0 in FB modal runtime text; (9) path sharing verified — facebookProfile.js + instagramProfile.js both import POST_IMG from data/social/postArtwork.js, all 6 SVGs return HTTP 200 image/svg+xml (1.7-3.0 KB). REGRESSION: Instagram grid still shows the same 6 individual motives, 0 broken; /, /news, /login load with 0 local broken images and 0 uncaught JS errors. ONE NEW FUNCTIONAL BUG: keyboard control of the photo lightbox (Escape / ArrowLeft / ArrowRight) is dead.

ui_bugs.issue: Photo lightbox keyboard handling is dead: Escape does NOT close it and ArrowRight/ArrowLeft do not navigate (verified: counter stays 'Fotos . 1 / 6'). Only the X button / backdrop closes it. Because the lightbox overlay stays up it also blocks all clicks on the FB tab bar (Playwright reports pointer-event interception on 'Fotos'/'Beitraege'), so a keyboard user is trapped.

No data-testid anywhere in /components/social/facebook/ (FacebookPreview, FacebookPostCard, FacebookMediaLightbox). Tabs, photo tiles, 'Alle ansehen', lightbox next/prev must be targeted via aria-label/text. Suggested: fb-tab-{beitraege,info,fotos,kontakt}, fb-photo-tile-{i}, fb-photo-view-all, fb-lightbox-{next,prev,close}, fb-post-{id}.

commentsCount is inconsistent with the rendered comment list (data: 4/5/3/6/4/3 vs. rendered 3/3/2/3/2/2 Kommentare). The card renders the real count, so commentsCount is either dead data or should match.

issues: Cover photo reuses POST_IMG.zinsen, i.e. the identical SVG as feed post 3 and photo 3 — duplicated motive in one view; the 1:1 SVG is also cropped hard in the wide cover slot (only the '%'/'3,50 - 3,85' fragment visible).

action_items: Fix lightbox keyboard: SocialPreviewModal.jsx line ~79 has onKeyDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} on the modal container. React's synthetic stopPropagation also stops the native event at the React root, so the window-level keydown listener in FacebookMediaLightbox (Escape/Arrow) never fires for events originating inside the FB modal. Either drop that handler or listen with capture on document in the lightbox.
Optional: give the Facebook cover its own artwork instead of reusing POST_IMG.zinsen (and use a wide-aspect asset).
Optional: add data-testid attributes to the Facebook preview tabs, photo tiles and lightbox controls.
Optional: align facebookProfile.posts[].commentsCount with the actual comments arrays.
critical_code_review_comments: postArtwork.js as single source of truth is correct — no duplicated asset paths between instagramProfile.js and facebookProfile.js (verified by import + runtime src equality).
Photo grids use loading='lazy'; automated broken-image checks must scroll the inner scroller first (offscreen tiles report naturalWidth 0 falsely). Assets themselves return 200/image/svg+xml.
SocialPreviewModal's blanket onKeyDown stopPropagation is a keyboard-a11y trap for any nested overlay — remove it rather than duplicating listeners per child.
seed_data_creation: none (static data files, localStorage bypass keys kapitalmitte_cookie_consent + kapitalmitte_visitor_profile only)
test_credentials: not needed (footer social icons are public); /app/memory/test_credentials.md not consulted for this frontend-only scope
context_for_next_testing_agent: Working recipe: set localStorage kapitalmitte_cookie_consent + kapitalmitte_visitor_profile, reload, then click [data-testid=social-footer-icon-facebook|instagram|linkedin]. FB tabs: get_by_role('button', name='Fotos'|'Beitraege'|'Info'|'Kontakt'). Lightbox: 'Alle ansehen' -> nav buttons aria-label 'Weiter'/'Zurueck', close aria-label 'Schliessen'; keyboard does NOT work (known bug). To read the lightbox image use the LAST div[role='presentation'].fixed (the outer preview modal is also role=dialog/aria-modal and matches first). Feed posts are <article> elements; scroll the inner scroller (elements with scrollHeight>clientHeight) several times to trigger lazy images before asserting naturalWidth. Still-open items from iteration_7: 63 hardcoded kundenservice@kapitalmitte.com strings in 33 non-social src files (visible on /faq), IG bio 'mehr'/'Website folgt' spacing, home-page '<path> d=undefined' SVG console error, Supabase stock-history 401 noise.
rca_of_the_issue: Facebook artwork bug from the user report is fixed: facebookProfile.js now imports POST_IMG from data/social/postArtwork.js and every post/photo references one of the 6 topic SVGs; runtime DOM confirms 6 distinct srcs in feed, photos tab and lightbox with no placeholder.svg used as post media (placeholder.svg remains only for commenter avatars / suggested pages, which is intended). New bug RCA: FacebookMediaLightbox registers its keydown handler on window, but SocialPreviewModal's container has onKeyDown={(e)=>e.stopPropagation()}; React 17+ attaches synthetic listeners at the root container and stopPropagation halts the native event there, so window never receives it -> Escape/Arrow keys inert inside the lightbox.
